title: docs: record Z-Image replica stop
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Records Vast instance `45311852` as stopped for overnight rollback.
- Updates the active Z-Image fleet cost to `$0.773333/hr` plus `$0.022222/hr` stopped storage.
- Records the clean post-stop verification: 27 successful requests across retained workers, zero 5xx/current-hour tunnel errors, and five passing shared-hostname health probes.
- Documentation only; no infrastructure, routing, registry, or secret changes.

gist.headline: The Z-Image night log
gist.blurb: One Z-Image worker has been tucked in for the night, with its rollback notes and clean health checks pressed neatly into the logbook.
gist.summary: Updated GPU_INSTANCES.md to record Vast instance 45311852 as stopped, document the Z-Image fleet's $0.773333/hr active and $0.022222/hr stopped-storage costs, and preserve post-stop verification results.
gist.impact: Maintainers have a concrete overnight rollback record, including 27 successful retained-worker requests, zero current-hour 5xx or tunnel errors, and five passing shared-hostname probes.
